atlas_n_mission.answer: E10: none -- no RESOURCE record in the fs crate, and no reason given; on the slice nothing at all resolved through imports. Hand bisection found one `slotmap::new_key_type! { pub struct TrashId; }` opening fs.rs, and a trace of the import fixed point found a period-2 oscillation opening every module of the slice

findings.question: which file handles do RealFs::save and RealFs::atomic_write acquire, and where are they released?
findings.ground_truth: Windows atomic_write: std::fs::File::create_new inside the smol::unblock closure, holder `file` released at the end of its inner block; Unix atomic_write: tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in, consumed by persist; save: smol::fs::File::create, moved into a BufWriter released at the end of save
findings.atlas_n: no acquisition claimed, no reason given
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: no acquisition claimed; fs.rs carries its cause -- 281 path calls withheld under item macro `slotmap::new_key_type!` at src/fs.rs:440, 2 under an unresolvable glob
findings.classification_n: ATLAS_CORRECT for std::fs::File::create_new (a sound refusal: rustc lets a macro-expanded `mod std` shadow the extern prelude silently, and the macro's expansion is not in the donor); OUT_OF_SCOPE for the tempfile and smol handles (non-std resources, outside the declared std-path table)
findings.classification_n_plus_1: ATLAS_CORRECT, now explained; the non-std handles stay OUT_OF_SCOPE

findings.question: why is a std-path call in fs.rs withheld?
findings.ground_truth: the module is open because `slotmap::new_key_type!` may define any name; bisection over 94 top-level item boundaries isolated it
findings.atlas_n: no answer (the pilot bisected by hand)
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: the component's `withheld`, GAP-OPEN-SCOPE and the unknowns lens name the macro, its line and the calls it withholds
findings.classification_n: UNDECIDABLE for the pilot through Atlas (the cause was not surfaced)

findings.question: do the slice's imports resolve?
findings.ground_truth: rustc builds them: `LanguageRegistry` is language_registry's struct in the type namespace only; buffer re-exports `crate::LanguageRegistry` and the crate root glob-imports buffer
findings.atlas_n: no fixed point within 64 rounds: every module of the slice opened, 0 resources, 7,648 INVOKES
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: the period-2 oscillation (an unsupported value-namespace placeholder travelling around the buffer <-> root re-export cycle) is merged conservatively: 9,059 INVOKES, 6 resources, 65 files open, each with its cause
findings.classification_n: DONOR_CORRECT (the compiler resolves what Atlas withheld; Atlas made no false claim)
findings.classification_n_plus_1: ATLAS_CORRECT for the edges gained (sample below); the remaining withheld calls sound

findings.question: are the new edges right?
findings.ground_truth: 20 of the 1,411 new INVOKES sampled at random (seed 162) and checked against the call site and the target's definition
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: 20 of 20 correct (free functions, associated functions, methods on typed receivers, calls inside closures and an async block); no E10 edge lost

findings.question: what do the 5,942 still-withheld calls wait on?
findings.ground_truth: dependency globs (rand::prelude::*), `actions!` (its expansion derives the proc macro gpui::Action), slotmap::new_key_type!, inventory::collect!, db::static_connection!, proptest!, and `super::*` globs of such modules
findings.classification: UNDECIDABLE without macro expansion (an ORACLE boundary: dependency source and proc-macro execution)

implementation.mechanism_vs_implementation: nothing of zed's implementation is absorbed; the donor exposed two Atlas defects of its own -- an import fixed point that oscillates on a re-export cycle, and a withheld path that gives no reason -- and one scale limit
implementation.change: adapter resolve: a period-2 oscillation of the import fixed point merged conservatively (agreed definitions kept, anything else Unknown); every module records why it is open (item macro, glob, module file, fixed point); WithheldPath for every path call withheld in an open scope; a multi-segment path whose first segment an open scope may shadow reported open-scope; runtime: one OPEN_SCOPE_DIAGNOSTIC per artifact on the CALL obligation; core composition: component `withheld`, GAP-OPEN-SCOPE, GAP-RESOURCE corrected (it still said there was no RESOURCE dimension); unknowns lens `withheld`; ADR 0077
implementation.falsification: 10 mutants killed (the oscillation merge disabled, conflicting and one-sided entries kept, withheld calls not collected, the first-segment check dropped, the macro-shadow cause dropped, causes overwritten, the component, lens and diagnostic wiring dropped); one equivalent mutant exposed a redundant return condition, removed
